{{Spell InfoBox|image=Deceptive_Mine.png|type=Spell Projectiles|rarity=Rare|mana_cost1=25|mana_cost2=38|mana_cost3=56|dmg1=70|dmg2=147|dmg3=309|crit_rate1=50%|crit_rate2=60%|crit_rate3=80%|effect_radius1=1.5m|effect_radius2=1.8m|effect_radius3=2.2m|misc_a_1=Indiscriminate Damage|misc_a_2=Indiscriminate Damage|misc_a_3=Indiscriminate Damage}}The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Rare]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Projectiles. When the default spell is cast, it fires out a spiked bomb that explodes damaging nearby enemies. If the bomb strikes a target, it explodes immediately. If it does not strike a target, it comes to a stop, blinks a few times, and then explodes.

'''Description:''' The name itself suggests its danger. Although people suspect it was created by abyssal creatures as a weapon against human, when its powerful explosion directly destroys an entire bone work, mages get reluctant to discard it into the reforge machine.

After landing, it stops moving. If it falls into the abyss, it disappears. When it explodes, it leaves attached elements on the ground.
